tours.title: Upload Income Certificate
tours.description: Step-by-step guidance to securely upload and mask your income proof.

steps.title: Document Center
steps.description: This is where you upload documents safely. Raw documents are processed in memory and discarded.

steps.title: Choose Document Type
steps.description: Select 'Income Certificate' from the dropdown list.

steps.title: Upload Document
steps.description: Select your PDF or image file (under 5MB).

tours.title: Complete Citizen Profile
tours.description: Update your profile details to unlock accurate scheme matching.

steps.title: Citizen Profile
steps.description: Your profile information is used for deterministic eligibility evaluation.

steps.title: Select State
steps.description: Choose your domicile state to find state-specific welfare benefits.

steps.title: Select Occupation
steps.description: Indicate your primary occupation (Farmer, Student, Worker, Artisan, etc.).

steps.title: Save Profile
steps.description: Save your details to immediately refresh your eligibility score.

tours.title: Discover Missed Welfare Benefits
tours.description: Find schemes you might qualify for based on your profile.

steps.title: Missed Benefit Detector
steps.description: We analyze your profile against national and state schemes to highlight missed entitlements.

steps.title: Potential Schemes
steps.description: Review the potential schemes and click 'Check Eligibility' to see satisfied and missing rules.

tours.title: Deterministic Eligibility Checker
tours.description: Understand exactly why you are eligible or what is missing.

steps.title: Select a Scheme
steps.description: Pick the government scheme you want to verify your eligibility for.

steps.title: Run Rule Engine
steps.description: Evaluate transparent rules: age, income threshold, occupation, landholding, and required documents.

tours.title: Family Benefit Optimizer
tours.description: Analyze entitlements across all members of your household.

steps.title: Family Members
steps.description: Add family members (children, spouse, elders) to calculate cumulative benefits.

steps.title: Analyze Family Entitlements
steps.description: Generate an entitlement matrix for your entire household.
